At least get the basics right. As an MLS fan, I’m very happy this app exists. Really wanted to like the new interface, but there are basic app functions that either work poorly or don’t work at all. First, the “Feedback” icon under user profile currently does nothing. Like, if you touch the image, it “clicks” from a haptics perspective, but that’s all. No new screen, no drop down menu, not even an “oops” error message. Just straight up nothing. Second, the “follow players” function is organized alphabetically by player FIRST NAME. While on the surface this might not seem problematic, I quickly discovered that it is seriously unhelpful. As a relatively engaged MLS consumer with a team that I watch and support weekly, I can confidently say I don’t know that I could even tell you the first names of the players on my own favorite team beyond maybe the starting eleven. The list also does not take diacritical marks into account, listing the same player twice because of this and listing other players out of alphabetical order entirely since their names start with letters that include diacritical marks. Given the amount of resources—financial and otherwise—being invested into MLS, I am disappointed and, frankly, embarrassed at the MLS app’s current quality. DO BETTER

Bait And Switch. On my NFL season pass, I can watch, for a year, all of the past games going back to the first game of the season. I thought that was what I was going to get with MLS Season Pass. 

After us subscribers discover that the streamed past games are only available for a few days after the original match, we are not happy. MLB and NFL have established what "Season Pass" means. Apple calls this product "Season Pass, but it does not live up to the industry standard. I thought I was buying a real season pass, but instead I got something which Apple calls a season pass, but which isn't. I feel duped.
 
 After an MLS match the only video available of it, after a couple of days elapse, is 7 minutes of " highlights."  I think it's a ripoff. I can get the same highlights on Youtube for free. MLS Season Pass is not a good value. It is like having a land-line or cable. You get stuck watching the games on the broadcaster's  timeline instead of your own.
